text:
liz: Heads-up — nightly perf CI (small-batch suite) flagged a p95 regression ~20% vs baseline for the 8k/kv-cache scenario. Failing job: job-2026-03-16-11. Posting traces + logs.
bench-bot: [alert] nightly-perf: p95_up 20% | tests: small-batch-8k-kvcache | job=job-2026-03-16-11 | snapshot=https://bench.internal/snap/job-2026-03-16-11 :rotating_light:
sam: Thanks — is this across all model variants or just quantized runs? any change in seq-len distribution in the run? :mag_right:
liz: Appears on both fp16 and 4bit runs, but worse on 4bit. Seq len histogram looks similar to baseline (most requests <512). Attaching a small excerpt of the failing tail from the worker logs:
```
[2026-03-16T03:14:22Z] worker-7 kernel_ms=12.4 kv_cache_miss=0.03 batch_size=6
[2026-03-16T03:14:23Z] worker-7 kernel_ms=18.9 kv_cache_miss=0.08 batch_size=4
[2026-03-16T03:14:23Z] worker-2 kernel_ms=21.1 kv_cache_miss=0.02 batch_size=1
```
jon: I saw a similar spike on the nightly shot earlier. Kernel scheduling jitter spiked on gpu-rt-3 around 03:10 UTC. I pushed a quick flamegraph to the snapshot: https://perf.internal/flame/job-2026-03-16-11
mara: I'll start a bisect across the commit window 6a1..d33 to see if any runtime change lines up. Planning to run targeted reproduce on local perf rig. Command I'll run:
```bash
./tools/run_smallbatch_repro --job job-2026-03-16-11 --seed 42 --collect-trace
```
sam: I'll try to repro on a dev node and also run kernel-level perf to check cuda scheduling (nvprof/hpc). If I can reproduce, I can try reverting the suspect PR in the canary branch.
claire: For priority — do we want an immediate canary rollback for tonight's hosted runs or keep running until we know root cause? We need to balance customer SLAs vs signal noise. :thinking:
liz: Decision: don't roll back yet. Mara + Sam to triage reproducer; Jon to monitor GPU jitter metric and post any infra alerts. If we hit >30% p95 or customer impact flags, escalate and rollback. I'll update the incident board.
mara: Starting bisect now, will post smallest bad commit. ETA ~45m. If I get a deterministic repro I'll tag @sam for kernel trace collection.
sam: Got it. If anyone sees a spike in p95 on dedicated pools, ping me directly. I'll queue up a perf job.
bench-bot: [snapshot uploaded] repro-logs and traces available: https://bench.internal/snap/repro-job-2026-03-16-11-try1
jon: One more note — small-batch queue depth increased briefly at 03:09 (autoscaler bounce). It may be compounding latency. I'm checking autoscaler logs now.
liz: Thanks team. Please post short updates here as you get them. I'll escalate to oncall if we hit the threshold. :thumbsup:
mara: First bisect result: bad commit d2f7a9c — touches scheduler path. Trying a revert patch now and will run reproducer.
sam: Running kernel trace against d2f7a9c revert branch. If the revert removes jitter, we can schedule a targeted canary rollback tomorrow morning.

claire: Copy. I'll draft rollback ops doc in case we need it fast. Linking here when ready.
